title: kith-store: AttachmentStore (metadata only)
description:
AttachmentStore: metadata-only insert, get by blob_id, list by message_id.

**What:** AttachmentStore wraps &Connection and stores attachment metadata rows; blob bytes managed by kith-attach.

**Algorithm:**
1. Define pub struct AttachmentStore<'a> { conn: &'a Connection }
2. insert(blob_id: &str, message_id: &str, filename: &str, content_type: &str, size_bytes: u64, sha256: &str, now_unix: i64) -> Result<(), KithError>:
   INSERT INTO attachments(id, message_id, filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
3. get(blob_id: &str) -> Result<Option<Attachment>, KithError>: SELECT by id
4. list_by_message(message_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Attachment>, KithError>: SELECT WHERE message_id=? ORDER BY created_at

**Defensive programming rules:**
- blob_id format validation (ULID) must occur at handler before calling store
- content_type validation (valid MIME) must occur at handler before calling store
- Store layer does NOT re-validate; trusts handler has done so
- size_bytes stored as INTEGER (u64 fits in i64 for reasonable file sizes)
- sha256 stored as TEXT (64 hex chars); no verification in store

**Tests:**
- insert then get returns identical metadata
- list_by_message returns all attachments for message in order
- DELETE from messages cascades to attachments (FK ON DELETE CASCADE)

**Acceptance:** cargo test -p kith-store: AttachmentStore tests pass; clippy clean.
